definitions.gloss: masterminding; plotting; being the ringleader of a plan or scheme
definitions.explanation: The act of planning and leading a plot, conspiracy, or organized action. Almost always carries a negative connotation, implying criminal activity, rebellion, or wrongdoing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{首謀者|しゅぼうしゃ}→首謀者：19171_shubousha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{逮捕|たいほ}→逮捕：03397_taiho⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The mastermind of the incident was arrested.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧クーデター⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{首謀|しゅぼう}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: He is said to have masterminded the coup.

examples.japanese: ⟦{詐欺|さぎ}→詐欺：09789_sagi⟧⟦グループ→グループ：03840_guruupu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{首謀者|しゅぼうしゃ}→首謀者：19171_shubousha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧わたって⟦{捜査|そうさ}→捜査：03688_sousa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{逃|のが}れていた→逃れる：10425_nogareru⟧。
examples.english: The ringleader of the fraud group had evaded investigation for many years.

notes:
Composed of {首|しゅ} (head, chief) + {謀|ぼう} (plot, scheme). Most commonly encountered in the compound ⟦{首謀者|しゅぼうしゃ}→首謀者：19171_shubousha⟧ (mastermind, ringleader). The word is strongly negative, associated with criminal plots, conspiracies, rebellions, and organized wrongdoing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{首謀者|しゅぼうしゃ}→首謀者：19171_shubousha⟧: mastermind, ringleader
- {首謀|しゅぼう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to mastermind, to plot
- ⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{首謀者|しゅぼうしゃ}→首謀者：19171_shubousha⟧: the mastermind behind the incident
- テロ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{首謀者|しゅぼうしゃ}→首謀者：19171_shubousha⟧: the mastermind of the terrorist attack

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{黒幕|くろまく}→黒幕：15478_kuromaku⟧: mastermind behind the scenes — implies pulling strings from a hidden position
- ⟦{主犯|しゅはん}→主犯：18011_shuhan⟧: principal offender — the legal term for the main perpetrator
- ⟦{張本人|ちょうほんにん}→張本人：26787_chouhonnin⟧: the person responsible — the one who is the root cause of trouble
